command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
CA_DIR=/etc/pki/ca-trust/os-comparison-root-ca
sudo -n mkdir -p "$CA_DIR"

echo "== STEP 1: generate CA private key =="
sudo -n openssl genrsa -out "$CA_DIR/ca.key" 4096

echo "== STEP 2: generate self-signed CA certificate =="
sudo -n openssl req -x509 -new -nodes -key "$CA_DIR/ca.key" -sha256 -days 3650 \
  -subj "/CN=OS Comparison Root CA" \
  -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE" \
  -addext "keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign" \
  -out "$CA_DIR/ca.crt"

sudo -n chmod 600 "$CA_DIR/ca.key"
sudo -n chmod 644 "$CA_DIR/ca.crt"

echo "== STEP 3: install into system trust anchors =="
sudo -n cp "$CA_DIR/ca.crt" /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.pem
sudo -n update-ca-trust extract

echo "== STEP 4: verify cert content =="
openssl x509 -in "$CA_DIR/ca.crt" -noout -subject -issuer -dates

echo "== STEP 5: verify trust store contains it =="
ls -la /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.pem
trust list | grep -A2 "OS Comparison Root CA" || true

echo "== STEP 6: verify via openssl verify against system bundle =="
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt "$CA_DIR/ca.crt"
